case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased Ashutosh is referred to with male pronouns.

victim_age.reason: The judgment never states the deceased's age; the value 30 has no support.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under Section 302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC is the charge and conviction provision.

weapon.reason: Axe, lathi and gun are all described as weapons used in the assault.

evidence_type.correct_value: eyewitness, circumstantial, recovery (inquest report and PW-19 evidence)
evidence_type.quote: the evidence of PW-13 is corroborated by material particulars by reliable testimony, direct and circumstantial
evidence_type.reason: No medical report is relied on; the inquest report and PW-19 evidence are the supporting material.

confession.correct_value: Disclosure statements by the appellants leading to recovery of weapons (as argued by the State)
confession.quote: pursuant to the disclosure made by the appellants, one blood stained wooden stick
confession.reason: The State relied on disclosures by the appellants leading to recoveries, so 'None' is not accurate.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are discussed beyond juvenility, which is treated as a legal status.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted both appellants under s.302/34 IPC.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction and sentence maintained; appeal dismissed
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court maintained the conviction and sentence and dismissed the appeal
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court did decide the appeal and upheld conviction, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appellant No.1's appeal dismissed (conviction upheld); appellant No.2's appeal allowed and remitted to Juvenile Justice Board
final_outcome.quote: We, however, allow the appeal of the appellant no.2 ... dismiss the appeal of the appellant no.1
final_outcome.reason: Appellant No.1 was not acquitted; his appeal was dismissed and conviction upheld.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Murder under s.302 IPC by appellant No.1
offence_finally_established.quote: we hold that the appellant no.1 was guilty of the offence under Section 302 of the IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: The Supreme Court held the s.302 offence established against appellant No.1.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Life imprisonment (trial court sentence upheld for appellant No.1)
imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced them to imprisonment for life and a fine of Rs.5000/- each
imprisonment_type.reason: Life imprisonment was imposed and upheld for appellant No.1; 'none' is wrong.

imprisonment_years.reason: Sentence is life imprisonment, with no fixed number of years stated.

fine_rs.quote: a fine of Rs.5000/- each and in default, to undergo further imprisonment for a period of one year
fine_rs.reason: The judgment states a fine of Rs.5000 each, so null is incorrect.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without outcome: appellant No.1 convicted and upheld; appellant No.2 remitted to Juvenile Justice Board
neutral_facts.quote: acquitted Subodh Nath based on the corroborated evidence
neutral_facts.reason: Wrongly states Subodh Nath was acquitted and reveals the court's outcome, which neutral facts must not do.

offence_severity.reason: Death by axe and gun under s.302 IPC is supported by the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim was killed, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: Injuries from axe and gun on the body are described in the inquest and PW-19 evidence.

number_of_offences.reason: Single charge under s.302/34 IPC, upheld for appellant No.1.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation is not discussed in the judgment.

post_offence_conduct.reason: PW-13's flight is explained by fear of the appellants, not treated as unreliability.
